interpretation_limits: Kernel union is a wall-time union, not a sum of kernel durations.
Island overlap and all-GPU idle are distinct measures; percentages may overlap and are not additive.
CUDA host API call-time sums overlap across CPU threads; use interval union for their wall-time footprint.
CPU stack sample hotspots are sampled attribution, not exact function wall time.
Uncaptured devices or missing graph-node events must be reported as coverage gaps, not treated as idle work.
